ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and flag the driver account for abuse of the "I'm Here" / waiting-fee button (NS-2).

rejected_claims.reason: Driver statement asserts he pressed 'I'm Here' and waited >3 min 'at the pickup'; GPS [F1][F2][F5] shows his closest approach was 545 m and he waited 600 m away with 0 s inside the 200 m range, so NS-1(ii)/(iii) fail. System records override statements.
Driver chat 'I'm here already' contradicted by GPS: he was 601 m away at the moment of the tap and never entered the pickup range [F1][F2][F5].
